spec_raw: The modus menu item includes a start-icon slot but not an end-icon slot. Applications need to place an icon at the end of a menu item.

spec_refined.title: Menu Item: add end-icon slot to modus-wc-menu-item
spec_refined.description: Add a new named slot `end-icon` to modus-wc-menu-item, positioned at the end (right side) of the item, mirroring the existing `start-icon` slot.
acceptance_criteria: A named slot `end-icon` exists in the menu-item shadow DOM
Content slotted into `end-icon` appears at the end of the menu item
The existing `start-icon` slot behavior is unchanged
The default slot still renders label content correctly
The readme.md documents the new end-icon slot
All existing menu-item spec tests pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Follow the existing start-icon pattern in modus-wc-menu-item.tsx. Add the slot in the render() method and position it using flex/tailwind classes.
